subject: red fox
title: A Fox Walked Into a Wolf Den and Came Out With a Pup

scenes.text: Wolves kill foxes. One night near Rome, it went the other way.
A camera watched a wolf den on an estate about twenty-five kilometres from the city.
A red fox slipped inside and dragged out a pup about one month old.
The pup broke free and ran back in. The fox went in after it and caught it again.
That pup was never seen again. Only one of the two pups survived.
It's the first time a fox has ever been recorded preying on a wolf pup. The hunted became the hunter.

description:
A camera trap at Castelporziano near Rome filmed a red fox entering a wolf den in May 2025 and dragging out a pup about a month old. The pup escaped back inside; the fox went in and caught it again.
That pup was never seen again, and only one of the litter's two pups survived. Researchers (Current Zoology, 2026) say it is the first documented case of a fox likely preying on a wolf pup.
Where were the adult wolves?

first_comment: The fox went back in a second time. Brave or reckless?
